purpose: Gold benchmark for occurrence splitting, role extraction, reading variants, genealogy, and sex uncertainty in early/classical 女X material. It is not an identity or cultural-family benchmark.
epistemic_rules: Surface 女 never directly determines sex.
A reading/transmission variant does not by itself establish historical identity beyond the textual witness relation.
Same-name occurrences remain distinct nodes until independent evidence supports a merge.
Maternal-line genealogy is an attested structure, not a universal semantic value of the graph 女.

cases.guard: The graph 子 in 少典之子 cannot be treated as male-only.
有子曰 is insufficient for sex inference; compare 女华 in the same chapter.
